name: Where Will You Go
source:
On this little patch of highway unremembered on the peninsula, a lone driver finds a wayward soul. Nobody could have seen the route life was about to take.

[From [url=https://mykanthrope.itch.io/where-will-you-go]Itch.io[/url]]
